subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core config surface now, and should this PR's opt-in `minimal`/`standard`/`full` semantics become the supported contract?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and proven, but choosing a new config/default surface affects prompt context, session behavior, hook extras, upgrade expectations, and overlapping bootstrap-control proposals.

options.title: Sponsor This PR Shape
options.body: Proceed with this additive config path after requiring public docs, a current-main rebase, and focused exact-head tests for resolver, hook, schema, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Bootstrap Selection
options.body: Pause this PR and design one broader selector contract for tiering, per-session filtering, hook extras, and related prompt-pressure work.

options.title: Decline The New Config Knob
options.body: Close or redirect the PR and keep users on existing `contextInjection`, bootstrap budgets, lightweight mode, and narrower bug fixes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor This PR Shape
recommendation.body: Proceed with this additive config path after requiring public docs, a current-main rebase, and focused exact-head tests for resolver, hook, schema, and upgrade behavior.
